# Skynet UI

> A tiny dark-first UI framework: one CSS file + one JS file, zero build steps, zero dependencies. 80+ styled components, ~400 Tailwind-named utilities with semantic colors, 9 themes, declarative data-sk-* behaviors, and an AI kit (safe markdown renderer, syntax highlighting, chat API with streaming). Designed so LLMs can generate correct, beautiful pages on the first try.

Quick start — paste into any HTML page:
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://skynetui.com/skynet-ui.css">
  <script src="https://skynetui.com/skynet-ui.js" defer></script>

## Docs

- [Full reference (llms-full.txt)](https://skynetui.com/llms-full.txt): every component, utility, theme, data attribute, and JS API, plus a step-by-step Tailwind → Skynet UI conversion guide. Read this before generating markup.
- [Pinned reference for v3.2.0](https://skynetui.com/v3.2.0/llms.txt): pinned copy for v3.2.0 (immutable; SRI hashes at /v3.2.0/sri.txt)

## Examples

- [Dashboard](https://skynetui.com/examples/dashboard.html): sidebar layout, stat cards, charts, tables
- [Chat app](https://skynetui.com/examples/chat.html): chat kit with markdown + streaming
- [Auth page](https://skynetui.com/examples/auth.html): centered card form with validation

## Tools

- [MCP server](https://skynetui.com/mcp): streamable-HTTP; tools get_reference, search_reference, get_theme_css, get_example
- [Theme builder](https://skynetui.com/themer.html): 9 presets, every variable, WCAG checks, shareable URLs
- [Playground](https://skynetui.com/play.html): paste markup, render instantly
- npm: `npm install skynet-ui` or `npm create skynet-ui` (scaffolds a themed landing/dashboard/chat/auth page)
